title: tree_monstor SOP Gates Definition
description: Schema for docs/sop/gates.json — defines the 4 development gates (TDD / lint / regression / reviewer) that agents must pass before declaring a task complete. This file is the single source of truth for gate definitions in tree_monstor/AGENTS.md §2.3.
$comment: Schema uses Draft-07 (not Draft 2020-12 as originally planned) because ajv-cli (the validation tool used by `npm install -g ajv-cli` and invoked via `ajv validate -s ... -d ...`) only supports Draft-07 and Draft 2019-09. Draft 2020-12 features (prefixItems, $dynamicRef, etc.) are not used here, so Draft-07 is functionally equivalent for this schema. To upgrade to 2020-12, switch from ajv-cli to ajv API (Node.js import). See TD-015.

version.description: Semantic version of this gates definition (e.g. "1.0.0"). Bump when adding/removing gates or changing pass_criteria semantics.

description.description: Human-readable description of the gates collection.

gates.description: Ordered list of gates an agent must pass (in order) before declaring a development task complete.

id.description: Stable gate identifier (e.g. "gate-1"). Used as the key in agent logs.

trigger_skill.description: Skill that orchestrates this gate (e.g. "/skill:tdd-test-writer"), or null if no skill is involved (e.g. lint gate uses language-specific tools).

pass_criteria.description: Conditions that must all be true to pass this gate. Each item is a plain English statement checked off in the agent's deliverable.

required_evidence.description: Concrete artifacts the agent must produce and cite in the conversation (e.g. test command output, lint output, screenshots). Pass-criteria without evidence is not valid.

fail_action.description: What the agent is forbidden to do if this gate fails (e.g. "不可寫作 code").

mandatory_phrase.description: Mandatory phrase the agent MUST cite verbatim (or close paraphrase) in the conversation when invoking this gate. Enforces that gate invocation is auditable and traceable to gates.json. See TD-016.

notes.description: Optional clarifications or context for this gate.

remediation.description: What the agent should do when this gate fails. Without this, behavior is undefined (some agents auto-fix, others stop and wait). See TD-019.

strategy.description: auto_fix = retry until pass (use for cheap fixes like lint); auto_fix_with_limit = retry up to max_attempts then fallback (use for gates that may need user input); ask_user = stop and ask the user immediately (use for high-stakes decisions like reviewer).

max_attempts.description: Maximum retry attempts for auto_fix_with_limit. Ignored for other strategies.

fallback.description: What to do when auto_fix_with_limit exhausts attempts. Default: ask_user (let the user decide next step).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the remediation behavior for this gate.
